data.description:
## Knowledge Needed
- Read: docs/design-git-training-data-structures.md (Bloom filter section)
- Understand: false positive rates and memory trade-offs
- Review: Python's hashlib for hash functions

## Implementation
Create cortical/utils/bloom_filter.py with:
1. BloomFilter class with configurable size and hash count
2. CommitBloomFilter specialized for SHA strings
3. Optimal size calculation: m = -n*ln(p) / (ln(2)^2)
4. Double hashing for k hash positions

## Guardrails
- DO: Make it generic (can be used for other deduplication)
- DO: Document false positive rate clearly
- DO: Provide memory_usage() method for monitoring
- DO NOT: Over-engineer - simple implementation is fine
- DO NOT: Use external bloom filter libraries
- EXPLORE: Whether to use bytearray vs. bitarray
- EXPLORE: Serialization for persistence across sessions

## Success Criteria
- 1% false positive rate at designed capacity
- 97%+ memory savings vs Set[str]
- O(1) add and contains operations
- Unit tests for edge cases (empty, at capacity, over capacity)
data.title: Implement Bloom filter for commit deduplication
